tasks.name: [UI20] a cancel with no dead task: the outcome line is the stop and its first reason line
[UI20] a cancel after a dead task, and a dead task: the outcome line is the dead task's state
[UI20] a rejected scenario with every task trusted: the outcome line is failed: acceptance not proved
[UI20] a done run with one parked scenario: the outcome line is done · 1 scenario not run
[UI20] a subtree run: the summary starts with the task id and title, then from spec and the spec title
[UI20] a spec that stopped validating and then validated again still gives the run-warning line
